name: pagecue
description: Lets Claude write and change your pagecue speaker cues live in the prompter.
long_description: pagecue is a Chrome extension: a private prompter window shows your speaker cues for the web page you present in Zoom, Meet or Teams. With this extension, Claude can see the page the prompter follows and add, change, show or remove cues there while you rehearse ("make cue 3 shorter"), and send a whole set of cues for a page. Everything stays on your computer: the extension talks to the pagecue Chrome extension through a small server on 127.0.0.1 only.

tools.name: pagecue_status
tools.description: The page the prompter follows, its cues and the current one.

tools.name: add_cue
tools.description: Add a cue at a heading or where the presenter is now.

tools.name: edit_cue
tools.description: Change a cue's headline or points.

tools.name: remove_cue
tools.description: Delete a cue (the presenter can undo it).

tools.name: show_cue
tools.description: Scroll the page and the prompter to a cue.

tools.name: set_view
tools.description: Section lines, pause, text size and theme.

tools.name: open_page
tools.description: Open a page in Chrome and follow it.

tools.name: publish_cues
tools.description: Send a whole set of cues for a page to the prompter.
